skill_name: Explain the difference between a web application and a native application
workflow: A web application is an application that is hosted on a web server and accessed through a web browser. A native application is an application that has been designed to run on a specific operating system or platform, such as iOS, Android or Windows. A web application can run on any platform as long as it has a web browser, while a native application must be specifically designed and coded for the platform it is to run on. Furthermore, web applications can update quickly across multiple platforms
